caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular area filled with a highly detailed, repetitive pattern resembling different types of textile or weaving samples. The area is divided into several horizontal bands, each with a unique texture pattern made up of small, closely packed shapes such as circles, ovals, and vertical lines, forming a grid-like structure. The patterns vary slightly in their density and repetition as they move from one band to another. The dominant color is a soft gray, created by the fine pencil or graphite lines on a cream or off-white background. There are no distinct objects other than the repetitive geometric forms. Below the rectangular patterned area, there is a faint inscription written in all caps that reads “MAUD M. 1902–7F.”
